Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: Hey, Cat Toy. Nice books. I'll be taking those.

Items.name: Laser Boy
Items.text: H-hey! Give those back, Bubba! My notes are in there!

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: Relax. Today's my last day in this dump anyway.

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: My letter from Platinum Prep came this morning. Watch me read my ticket out of here.
Bubba tears open the envelope. His grin fades as he reads.
Without a word, Bubba shoves back from the table and storms out, Bobby's books still under his arm.

Items.name: Laser Boy
Items.text: My books...
"<Name>, please report to the principal's office. <Name>, to the principal's office."
[PLACEHOLDER: Principal Fi's office. This plays over black until the room is built.]

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: Ah, <Name>. Come in, have a seat.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: I heard all about yesterday at the bank. Holding your nerve with a gun pointed at you...

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: Getting into that goon's head for the code. That was quick thinking. I'm proud of you.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: But I'll be honest with you: hero work is dangerous. Even for those of us with simple powers.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: The heroes who last are the ones who don't go it alone.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: Working with others keeps you safer, and it makes winning a whole lot easier.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: So make some friends here, <Name>. Good ones. That's my advice.

Items.name: Principal Fi
Items.text: Now, off you go. I believe you have a class to get to.
On your way out, you think about Bobby's books. Where would Bubba have gone?
Maybe somewhere quiet... like the library.
Psych
